data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in PKBK, PLBC, and TSBK.

On September 24, 2026, PKBK disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1315399/000143774926031135/pkbk20260923_8k.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and discuss a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
